subject: Kickoff: Dedicated GPU pool MAP & throughput targets (Acme AI)
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Ava Jensen <ava.jensen@acme.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-05T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Kickoff: Dedicated GPU pool MAP & throughput targets (Acme AI)

Hi Ava —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. We’re excited to kick off the mutual action plan (MAP) for your dedicated GPU pool. Attached is a first draft of the MAP (Acme_MAP_v1.0.docx) and a quick throughput worksheet (throughput_estimates.csv).

High-level goals for this MAP:
- Deliver a dedicated GPU pool capable of sustaining 120k tokens/minute with 95% of requests under 200ms p50 after rollout.
- Complete onboarding, security review, and procurement signoff within an 8-week window to align with your pilot launch.

Key asks from Acme for the kickoff workshop:
1) Confirm stakeholders and owners for capacity, networking, and procurement.
2) Share representative traffic patterns (peak qps, avg seq length, burst durations) — we’ve attached a template.
3) Agree on success criteria for the pilot (latency, throughput, SLOs, cost target).

Suggested agenda for the 60-minute kickoff workshop (please pick 2 slots below):- Introductions & roles (10m)
- Workload & traffic review (15m)
- Capacity targets & GPU pool sizing (15m)
- Rollout plan & milestones (10m)
- Action items & owners (10m)

Proposed owners from Redwood: Marissa (capacity design), Rishi (runtime/throughput), Monica (onboarding/security). I’ll lead the MAP coordination.

Available times: 2026-03-05 11:00-12:00 PT, 2026-03-05 15:00-16:00 PT, 2026-03-06 09:00-10:00 PT.

Next steps: please confirm a slot and attach any traffic samples you can share. I’ll update the MAP doc with the meeting notes and owners.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
[jordan.blake@redwood.com]

Attachments: Acme_MAP_v1.0.docx (MAP draft), throughput_estimates.csv (template)

From: Ava Jensen <ava.jensen@acme.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@acme.ai, procurement@acme.ai
Date: 2026-03-05T11:24:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Dedicated GPU pool MAP & throughput targets (Acme AI)

Jordan —

Thanks for the clear plan. We can do the kickoff today at 3pm PT (your 15:00 slot). Confirmed attendees from Acme: myself (product lead), Rajesh Patel (infra lead) — ops@acme.ai will include him — and Lina Torres from procurement (procurement@acme.ai) for timeline/contract questions.

We’ll try to attach a 48-hour traffic capture by EOD; full historical logs will follow by Monday.

Initial priorities from our side:
- Ensure the pool can handle bursty spikes (we observed ~40k token/min spikes last month).
- Minimal cold-start latency for short chat flows (avg seq length ~60 tokens).
- Encryption-at-rest and audit logging — Lina will want the SOC2 evidence you mentioned.

See you at 3pm PT.

Best,
Ava Jensen
Head of Product, Acme AI
ava.jensen@acme.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-05T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Dedicated GPU pool MAP & throughput targets (Acme AI)

Jordan / team —

Thanks — looped Stephanie (our solutions PM) so she can take notes on the MAP milestones and own the follow-ups backlog. Quick notes before the kickoff: 
- I'll present two sizing options: conservative (reserve + autoscale) and aggressive (higher base, smaller autoscale headroom).
- Need Rajesh’s expected sustained qps and 95th/99th percentile seq lengths to pick quantization + kernel targets.
- Rishi — can you bring a short slide on runtime tradeoffs (batching vs. latency, KV cache expectations)?

Also adding a short on-call escalation path for GPU pool incidents (SRE contact vs. customer ops).

Marissa
Senior Solutions Eng, Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Ava Jensen <ava.jensen@acme.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, procurement@acme.ai
Date: 2026-03-05T12:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Dedicated GPU pool MAP & throughput targets (Acme AI)

Perfect — 3:00pm PT confirmed. I’ll send a calendar invite with the agenda and the MAP link.

Pre-kickoff checklist (please confirm):
- Acme: 48-hour traffic capture uploaded to the shared Drive (link below) — yes/no
- Acme: point of contact for networking (NAT, VPC peering) — name/email
- Redwood: SOC2 summary and KMS/HSM options (Monica will lead) — confirmed

Shared folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cAcme-MAP

If procurement needs a draft contract to review before the workshop, Monica — can you share the standard Dedicated contract redline?

Thanks,
Jordan

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-06T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Throughput estimates for kickoff

Jordan / Marissa —

Attached a quick CSV (throughput_estimates.csv) with three scenario rows: baseline (40k tokens/min sustained), peak burst (120k tokens/min for 5 minutes), and projected ramp (3x over 8 weeks). Notes:
- Baseline sizing: 4x A100-equivalent nodes with continuous batching expected p50 latency ~150ms for seq=60.
- Burst headroom: autoscale policy needs to allow 2 additional nodes with sub-90s spin-up or use warm standby to meet the 200ms p50 SLA.
- KV cache: 30% hit expected for chat flows — propose cache-coherent placement to reduce token compute.

I’ll be on the kickoff to walk through these numbers and tradeoffs.

-Rishi
Principal Runtime Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachment: throughput_estimates.csv

From: Ava Jensen <ava.jensen@acme.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajesh Patel <ops@acme.ai>, Lina Torres <procurement@acme.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-06T14:32:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Dedicated GPU pool MAP & throughput targets (Acme AI)

Jordan / team —

Great kickoff earlier — thanks everyone for the clarity. Quick recap and next items from Acme: 
- We agree on the MAP milestones and the 8-week target for pilot go-live.
- Rajesh will share VPC peering contact details and the 7-day historical traffic extract by tomorrow morning.
- Procurement (Lina) requested a copy of the Dedicated contract and an outline of billing cadence — Lina, looping you to coordinate offline.

Action owners documented in the MAP are fine — one note: can Redwood include a short rollback plan if we observe quality regressions post-traffic ramp? We’d like an A/B fallback to warm-hosted endpoints.

Looking forward to Rishi’s finalized throughput sheet and Marissa’s sizing decision.

Best,
Ava
Head of Product, Acme AI
